def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter

    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    signal = next(v for v in counts if v != bg)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Continue each row's observed pattern to the right. Infer the shortest
    # period of the non-background sequence and mark predicted signal cells.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        positions = [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
        if not positions:
            continue
        end = positions[-1]
        seq = row[:end + 1]
        period = len(seq)
        for p in range(1, len(seq) + 1):
            if all(seq[i] == seq[i % p] for i in range(len(seq))):
                period = p
                break
        for c in range(end + 1, w):
            predicted = seq[c % period]
            if predicted == signal and row[c] == bg:
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
